answer: To keep throwaway identities from packing the roster, make settlement depend on a unique custody trail: each agent posts a small slashable reserve in a vault bound to one signing key, then must finish a one-off observational task that cannot be copy-pasted across a farm. A falcon monitor flags keys that sprout together like a dune after the same funding pulse; those keys lose the reserve and stay off the grading roster until they produce work no sibling shares. Volume can still arrive, but it cannot convert into seats the same afternoon.
